integrity: An unrestricted three-case proof is supplied. A standalone exact-integer checker tests finite cases as supplementary evidence, not as an infinite proof. No independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: For bases b>=3 and positive power gaps b^k only; does not treat b=2, general gaps, or aggregated distribution. Literature overlap outside indexed and inspected sources remains possible.
title: Exact power-of-base differences of nonbinary palindromes
